items.basis: Still in limited Vertex AI preview as of Jul 11 — no model card, benchmarks or pricing published. Reporting holds a Jul 17 target framed as a ground-up base-model rebuild (math, SVG, image quality, 2M context). Polymarket ~71% by Jul 31.
